import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame):
    # Keep only numeric columns
    numeric_df = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).copy()

    # Handle the case with no numeric data
    if numeric_df.shape[1] == 0 or numeric_df.shape[0] == 0:
        result = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"],
            index=df.index,
        )
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
        ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")
        return result, ax

    # Replace missing values with column means; if a column is entirely NaN, fall back to 0
    numeric_df = numeric_df.apply(lambda col: col.fillna(col.mean()))
    numeric_df = numeric_df.fillna(0)

    # PCA can only use up to min(n_samples, n_features) components
    n_components = min(2, numeric_df.shape[1], numeric_df.shape[0])
    if n_components == 0:
        result = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"],
            index=df.index,
        )
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
        ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")
        return result, ax

    pca = PCA(n_components=n_components)
    components = pca.fit_transform(numeric_df)

    # Pad to always provide two output columns
    if components.shape[1] < 2:
        components = np.hstack(
            [components, np.zeros((components.shape[0], 2 - components.shape[1]))]
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        components[:, :2],
        columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"],
        index=df.index,
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=result,
        x="principal component 1",
        y="principal component 2",
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
    ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")

    return result, ax
